visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Studio setting. A man with black hair and glasses, wearing a vertically striped black-and-white shirt over a white t-shirt, stands in front of a gray pegboard and wooden shelves. He gestures energetically towards the camera with a cheerful expression. (2) Night fishing scene. The man is on a boat deck at night, wearing a yellow life jacket and holding a fishing rod. The water is illuminated by vibrant green underwater lights. Other people are visible in the background leaning over the railing. (3) Sunset scene. The man stands heroically on the boat deck against a purple and orange dusk sky, wearing white-framed goggles and a life jacket. (4) Digital interface transition. A screen recording of a mobile travel website shows the Tripbaa logo followed by detailed listings for night fishing tours in Keelung, including prices and ratings. (5) Food preparation. A chef on the boat is seen preparing seafood and meat on a large grill. Plated shrimp and raw pork belly are shown in close-up. (6) Travel catalog. The screen recording rapidly scrolls through various activities including skiing, waterfalls, glamping, and hot spring resorts with colorful icons. (7) Studio conclusion. The man returns to the initial studio setting, pointing at an on-screen QR code and adjusting his glasses while delivering a call to action with high energy.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian male with black hair, wearing black-framed glasses and a black-and-white vertically striped shirt over a white undershirt. He later wears a yellow life jacket and white-rimmed goggles on the boat.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video alternates between a well-lit studio with a gray pegboard wall, a boat deck at sea under night lights and sunset skies, and a digital interface showing a mobile web application.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Speech begins with high energy and clarity. A male voice introduces the topic over an upbeat electronic pop BGM with a consistent rhythmic beat. The studio environment sounds clean with no noise floor. (2) Transition to outdoor boat scene. A subtle low-frequency atmospheric hum of a boat engine and wind is layered beneath the primary vocal. The music energy remains high. (3) Shift back to a technical presentation style. A digital UI 'whoosh' sound marks the appearance of the travel platform logo. The ambient boat noise is cut, leaving only the studio-grade vocal and BGM. (4) Promotional detail phase. The vocal tempo increases slightly as features are listed. Background electronic synthesizers provide a bright, energetic texture. (5) Conclusion and CTA. The voice takes on a more authoritative, commanding tone. The music builds briefly in intensity before a sharp hard-cut ending accompanied by a resonant percussive outro thud.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Platform Introduction -> Feature Breakdown -> Diverse Options -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the travel platform 'Tripbaa 趣吧!' by showcasing a personal experience of night fishing and highlighting the platform's variety of travel products and informative guides.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator provides a direct verbal recommendation, displays the brand logo throughout, shows the website interface, and includes a QR code for direct access to the service.
